scope:
One continuous open-start grasp/transport evaluation of local mechanics.

Fresh generation uses static equations only; task simulation never selects a
candidate. --plan/--goal are explicit development replay options, not catalogues.

fit.structure_scope: two-pad seed; branch lengthening at fixed contact count; free pads or legal one/two-link additions at any free port
fit.selection_rule: first fully screened candidate; round robin over contact count, approach and mode, bounded branch growth; physical execution unverified

assumptions: zero rotor spin and reaction torque
rigid dock seam; latch transients not modeled
source simulation PD/armature; not identified hardware response
backlash, backdrive friction and electrical/thermal drive limits not modeled
